name: Camino de la Plata Open 2023

venue.name: [Centro Comercial Camino de la Plata](https://cccaminodelaplata.es/)
venue.address: Av. de Castilla y León, 22, 09006 Burgos

information:
Los miembros de la **AES** recibirán un reembolso del 15% al concluir el campeonato.
Si has nacido en la provincia de **Burgos** o vives allí, al concluir la competición recibirás un reembolso del 50% al concluir el campeonato. Habrá que justificarlo mandando un correo a la organización del campeonato.
Los descuentos **NO** son acumulables, se tendrá en cuenta solo el mayor de los dos.

Members of the **AES** will receive a 15% refund at the end of the competition.
If you were born in the province of **Burgos** or live there, at the end of the competition you will receive a 50% refund at the end of the competition. It will be necessary to justify it by sending an email to the organization of the competition.
The discounts are **NOT** cumulative, only the larger of the two will be taken into account.
